assistant.welcomeMessage: Hi, I'm Roger — the MedRisk Lite assistant. Ask me about FMEA, RPN/ALARP scoring, ISO 14971 compliance, or how to use this app. Attach a file, or use the quick prompts to get started.
assistant.inputPlaceholder: Ask Roger anything, or about this FMEA data…
quickPrompts: What is the highest-risk failure mode right now?
Explain RPN and ALARP in simple terms.
Draft a mitigation plan for the housing seal failure.
What does IEC 62366-1 usability engineering cover?

report.fmeaReportDesc: Generates a structured PDF — cover page, objectives, the full FMEA table, mitigation notes, and an ISO 14971:2019 compliance summary — ready to include in a risk-management file.
fmeaReportBullets: Complete FMEA table with Severity, Occurrence, Detectability, RPN and ALARP classification
Compliance summary and mitigation notes for every documented failure mode
report.manualDesc: Generates a walkthrough PDF explaining how to use MedRisk Lite — every tab, the sign-in flow, and the AI Assistant — useful as a leave-behind document for a mentor or reviewer.

settings.aiAssistantDesc: Roger answers from a free built-in knowledge base by default. An administrator can set GROQ_API_KEY on the server to unlock full AI conversation with the model below — no app changes needed either way.
settings.rogerScopeSub: How Roger handles questions outside FMEA/this app
settings.dataManagementDesc: Export a full backup, restore from one, or reset back to the seeded demo data set.
settings.webOnlyExportNote: Export downloads only on the web build in this version.
settings.importFailedBody: Make sure this is a MedRisk Lite backup file.
settings.resetConfirmBody: This replaces all failure modes, compliance clauses and snapshots with the original seeded ultrasound-probe data set. This cannot be undone.
